objective: Eliminate paid search spend waste on non-converting broad-match search terms

evidence.context: Platform shows 4.2x ROAS based on form-fills
Form-fills from broad match keywords fail sales qualification (only 4% accepted vs 22% benchmark)

assumptions: CRM deal attribution window is set to 30 days
Sales qualification criteria remained consistent over the last 60 days
unresolved_questions: Are non-converting broad match terms contributing to top-of-funnel retargeting audiences?
diagnosis: Google Ads platform reports artificial 4.2x ROAS due to counting unverified e-book downloads as conversions. Downstream CRM reconciliation reveals broad match campaign 'US_Search_Generic' incurs $480 CPA (target: $250).

alternatives_considered.alternative: Increase overall campaign budget to scale conversions
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Scales low-quality lead volume without improving CAC or sales pipeline acceptance

proposed_action: Pause the 5 lowest-performing broad-match ad groups in campaign 'US_Search_Generic' and reallocate $2,500 monthly budget to exact match branded and high-intent term campaigns.
expected_mechanism: Stopping spend on non-converting queries directly reduces wasted ad spend, driving blended CRM CPA down toward target.

cost.opportunity_cost: Potential slight drop in raw top-of-funnel lead count

dependencies: Access permissions for Google Ads API / Campaign Manager
risks: Temporary reduction in total raw lead volume
guardrails: Sales accepted pipeline volume must not drop below 15 opportunities/week
rollback_guidance: Unpause paused ad groups via action capability contract rollback script if qualified lead volume drops > 20%.

short_sequence.task: Pause 5 underperforming broad-match ad groups in campaign US_Search_Generic
short_sequence.completion_evidence: Google Ads Change History log entry

long_sequence.task: Implement Google Ads Offline Conversion Tracking (OCT) with HubSpot deal stages
long_sequence.expected_impact: Passes real revenue signals back to Google Smart Bidding
long_sequence.completion_evidence: HubSpot-Google Ads conversion action status active
